user.title: Set up Novy Pureline Pro
user.description: Select a nearby Pureline Pro device or choose to enter a MAC address manually.

manual.title: Enter MAC Address
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Novy Pureline Pro extractor hood.

error.invalid_mac: Invalid Bluetooth MAC address format. Expected format: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF

abort.no_devices_found: No Pureline Pro devices found nearby.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported Novy Pureline Pro.

data.ambi_on_delayed_off: Switch light to ambi on Delayed Off

data_description.ambi_on_delayed_off: When the Delayed Off button is pressed, also switch the light to the ambi preset (like the hood's own firmware). Leave off when Home Assistant controls the light itself, e.g. with Layers.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends a raw command frame to the hood, for commands without an entity or for protocol exploration. Frame format: [command;arg1;arg2;...].

config_entry_id.name: Hood
config_entry_id.description: The Pureline Pro to send to. Can be left empty when only one hood is configured.

args.name: Arguments
args.description: List of integer arguments, for example [1, 3].

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Request a status report afterwards so the entities update.

entry_not_found.message: No Novy Pureline Pro with config entry id {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: Novy Pureline Pro {entry_id} is not loaded.

no_entry_loaded.message: No Novy Pureline Pro is loaded.

multiple_entries.message: Several hoods are configured; specify config_entry_id.
